items.title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
items.description: Five years after the Taliban’s return, the BBC follows senior figures as the group reshapes the country.

items.title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
items.description: The fire has burned around 10,500 acres and is completely uncontained, officials say.

items.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
items.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

items.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
items.description: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

items.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
items.description: Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.

items.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
items.description: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.

items.title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
items.description: Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.

items.title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
items.description: The former skippers say it is "basic decency" for Pakistan to comply with a court-ordered medical assessment.

items.title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
items.description: Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.

items.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
items.description: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.

items.title: Four arrested over boxing champion's murder in South Africa
items.description: One of the suspects is due in court on Monday to be charged with murder and attempted murder.

items.title: Australian shark attack victim grateful for 'second chance at life'
items.description: Leah Stewart was mauled by a shark in June, suffering multiple bites to her arms and legs.

items.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 31
items.description: A mound of rubbish at a major waste site buried several homes in the capital, the government says.

items.title: Shein aims for almost $27bn valuation in stock market debut
items.description: The fast-fashion giant's shares are due to start trading in Hong Kong on 1 September.

items.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
items.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.

items.title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
items.description: Representatives met in Switzerland to work out next steps to resolve the conflict.

items.title: Zelensky should be asked what he knew about government corruption, sacked minister tells BBC
items.description: Mykhailo Fedorov has also called for wartime elections to be held in Ukraine.

items.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
items.description: No group has claimed responsibility for the attacks, which the military said "aimed at creating unrest".

items.title: Frustration builds in Indiana town struggling without power for 12 days
items.description: In the town of Gary, where a third of residents live in poverty, people say they have been living in "survival mode".

items.title: 'Half my business will be gone' - Firms in Canada and US fear trade war
items.description: Business owners in both countries are navigating uncertainty and worry as the tit-for-tat import taxes ratchet up.
